note: Positive means barrier/failure fixture; negative means minimal control, exception, or non-failure fixture.

positive: unmuted autoplay video soundtrack no controls
WebAudio oscillator on load no mute
same-origin iframe autoplay parent no control
multiple autoplay tracks one pause leaves another
fake volume slider does not affect audio
background music mislabelled as conference call
negative: audio starts only after user Play click
auto sound stops at 3s or less
mute button reduces gain/volume to zero
global pause stops all audible autoplay

positive: carousel auto-advances more than 5s no pause
spinner loops beside readable content forever
stock ticker auto-updates every second no pause
autoplay background video moves more than 5s no controls
focus starts animation that continues automatically
auto-dismissing alert removes content without pause
negative: video has controls or pause button
animation only while user intentionally holds interaction
each moving item has working pause
status update remains or can be paused

positive: same-origin iframe contains large flashing ad
cumulative small flash tiles exceed area threshold
focus triggers flashing warning more than 3Hz
negative: smooth canvas animation without abrupt flashes
tiny isolated icon below area threshold

positive: modal cycles Tab Shift+Tab Esc ignored no close
contenteditable captures Tab forever no advice
iframe/plugin consumes all keys no escape
canvas game captures Tab/arrows no exit docs
shadow DOM focus loop never leaves host
nonstandard exit exists but not advised
negative: editor advises Alt+F10 and it works
canvas says Press Esc to leave and works
composite uses arrows internally but Tab exits

positive: focus field opens modal and moves focus
checkbox opens new window no warning
negative: focus shows tooltip/help without moving focus
radio changes inline panel focus remains

positive: carousel next only via horizontal swipe
rotate image only by two-finger rotate
pointerdown deletes item immediately no undo
slider only changes by dragging thumb
negative: activation on up or undo appears
mouseup inside target required with move-away cancel
tap menu or arrows move item

positive: character sequence g then a action
question mark opens help globally no off
presentation j/k changes slides globally no off
negative: shortcuts active only when component focused
shortcut can be off/remapped for locale
